content.value_statement: GDPR and DSGVO work requires consistent legal, technical, and audit evidence. This skill structures assessments, DPIAs, rights workflows, transfer reviews, and audit readiness for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Design GDPR and DSGVO compliance checklists for legal basis, rights, accountability, and transfers.
Guide DPIA threshold checks, execution steps, documentation, and review planning.
Map data subject rights intake, identity verification, response, and documentation workflows.
Review German DSGVO and BDSG considerations, including supervisory authority coordination.
Prepare GDPR audit scopes, criteria, findings, reports, and remediation plans.
Support international transfer mechanism reviews and supplementary measures assessments.
limitations: Does not replace qualified legal counsel or an appointed data protection officer.
Cannot verify live processing systems unless the user provides evidence.
May require updates when EU, German, or sector guidance changes.
Referenced resource names in SKILL.md may not exist as bundled files.

use_cases.title: Run Compliance Gap Reviews
use_cases.description: Assess processing activities against GDPR and DSGVO requirements, then produce prioritized remediation actions.

use_cases.title: Plan DPIAs for New Products
use_cases.description: Identify DPIA triggers, privacy risks, mitigation measures, and review checkpoints before launch.

use_cases.title: Prepare Audit Evidence
use_cases.description: Organize records, policies, rights responses, and transfer documentation for internal or external audits.

prompt_templates.title: Check GDPR Basics
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of one processing activity.
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this processing activity for GDPR and DSGVO gaps: [describe activity]. Identify lawful basis, data categories, rights impacts, documentation needs, and immediate risks.

prompt_templates.title: Draft DPIA Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a DPIA plan for [system or process]. Cover threshold analysis, processing description, risks, mitigation measures, stakeholders, and review cadence.

prompt_templates.title: Review International Transfer
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of cross-border data movement.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this international data transfer: [transfer details]. Assess transfer mechanism, third-country risks, supplementary measures, documentation gaps, and escalation points.

prompt_templates.title: Build Audit Program
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced preparation for a privacy audit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a GDPR and DSGVO audit program for [organization or unit]. Include scope, criteria, evidence requests, interview topics, findings format, and remediation tracking.

output_examples.input: A SaaS team plans to add product analytics for EU users.
output_examples.output: The assessment flags lawful basis, transparency, retention, processor contracts, and opt-out controls. It recommends a DPIA screen before implementation.

output_examples.input: A hospital wants to transfer clinical research data outside the EEA.
output_examples.output: The review lists transfer mechanism choices, health data safeguards, supplementary measures, patient transparency needs, and supervisory consultation triggers.

output_examples.input: An internal auditor needs a GDPR audit checklist.
output_examples.output: The output groups evidence requests by governance, records, DPIAs, rights handling, breach response, transfers, training, and remediation ownership.

best_practices: Provide the processing purpose, data categories, systems, countries, processors, and retention periods.
Ask for evidence-based outputs, such as audit criteria, required records, and remediation owners.
Validate legal conclusions with counsel before relying on them for regulatory decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a final legal opinion without human legal review.
Do not omit system, processor, or transfer details from compliance assessments.
Do not treat generated checklists as proof that controls are implemented.

faq.question: Can this skill provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It supports structured analysis, but qualified counsel should approve legal positions.

faq.question: Does it cover both GDPR and German DSGVO topics?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill covers GDPR requirements and German implementation considerations, including BDSG coordination.

faq.question: Can it help with DPIAs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can structure DPIA threshold checks, risk analysis, mitigation planning, and documentation reviews.

faq.question: Can it manage data subject rights requests?
faq.answer: It can design request workflows, verification steps, timelines, response content, and documentation practices.

faq.question: Does it connect to compliance systems?
faq.answer: No. It works from user-provided information and does not connect to live systems by itself.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
